Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vimla - 62 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Pihu - 12 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Pihu stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Aarav: "Yes, all right."

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Aarav: "Really?"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Pihu: "Let's see."

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Pihu (softly): "One more time!"

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, all right."

[Snow begins to fall.]

Aarav: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
